name: Buy Button Plus – Connect to Shopify
author: Jasper Studio

sections.description:
Shopify’s powerful e-commerce, WordPress’s freedom.

This plugin connects your Shopify store with WordPress, so you don’t have to choose between two systems. Sell Shopify products directly on your site, with Shopify’s trusted Checkout. Just drop in Buy Buttons on any post or page without changing your design.

Create a Buy Button with the Shopify Buy Button Plus app. Drop it anywhere in your site and watch the sales roll in.

  • Always in sync. Product updates in Shopify automatically update on your site.
  • Launch fast. Create discounts and promos in minutes.
  • Earn while you sleep. Sell digital or physical subscriptions.
  • Track what converts. See which buttons drive the most sales
  • Never lose a ready buyer. Add a cart that’s available on every page.
  • Install in seconds using the plugin shortcode

External services

connects to your Shopify store to display product information, handle shopping cart functionality, and process checkouts. This plugin doesn’t store any data in Shopify.

This plugin also connects to Buy Button Plus to display your Buy Button. It sends your website’s domain for analytics purposes.

All data transmission occurs over HTTPS. Product and cart data is temporarily stored in the user’s browser local storage for cart persistence across page visits. The script which connects to Shopify and Buy Button Plus is loaded from buybuttonplus.dev.

This service is provided by “Buy Button Plus”: Privacy Policy, Terms of Service
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Buy Button Plus in the WordPress admin and enter your Buy Button ID
  4. Use the shortcode in your posts, pages, or widgets – anywhere you want to sell a product
sections.faq:
Will this slow down my site?

No. The Buy Button Plus script is lightweight and loads asynchronously—so your WordPress site stays fast.

How does this compare to WooCommerce?

WooCommerce is great for site owners who want to run a full ecommerce store in WordPress. For site owners who are content-first, Buy Button Plus separates the commerce layer and the content layer, so both are easier to manage. You get the flexibility of WordPress, and the world-class, easy-to-use e-commerce of Shopify.

Is this plugin secure?

Yes, all inputs are properly sanitized using WordPress security functions to prevent XSS attacks.

Will the script be added to all pages?

Yes, the script tag will be injected into the head section of all pages on your site.
